historical_record.description: The City Planning Commission approved the Determination of Compliance and Exceptions under Section 309 of the Planning Code to convert floors 2 through 4 of the historic 10-story Hales Warehouse and Food Shop building into approximately 24 residential dwelling units at 410 Jessie Street.
The historic 10-story Hales Warehouse and Food Shop building stood at the property.
